text: anya: dropping a quick design check for the roles matrix tweaks in the invite drawer. goal: make inherit/SSO/audit discoverable without forcing people into a separate panel. figma: https://figma.redwood.app/file/roles-matrix-compact-v4 sam: skimmed. main implementation constraint: don't add extra backend calls; we can compute `source` client-side from membership payload. prefer visible short labels over hover-only state for touch. lucy: UX concern: focus order is weird when the row expands inline keyboard jumps from the role chip to kebab and skips the expanded details. we should ensure expand control is before kebab in DOM and tabbable. kevin: accessibility checklist: 1) SSO badge must meet 4.5:1 for small text; current color fails. 2) aria-labels for badges: e.g., aria-label="SSO required for this user" and aria-label="Via team: infra (inherits this role)". 3) when tooltip is visible swap aria-describedby so SRs don't read both badge and tooltip. faye: copy Q: we have "Assign role" vs "Add role" in different places. let's standardize to "Assign role" across invite/mobile/drawer. less ambiguous. anya: decision candidates: A) standardize verb = "Assign role"; B) show primary role chip + compact badges: 'Via: ' and SSO icon; C) inline 'Audit' link for rows with events in last 30d; D) ensure expand control is first tabbable element in row; E) virtualization + lazy-render for large lists. objections? sam: thumbs up. i'll compute client-side labels and add a small helper util `formatSourceShort()` in the component lib so copy is consistent. kevin: small CSS + aria snippet for the component doc: ``` Viewer 🔒 SSO Via: infra Audit ``` plus: `.sso { background:#07263a; color:#fff }` and `:focus-visible { outline-offset:3px }`. lucy: add keyboard acceptance criteria: Tab order should land on expand -> first role chip -> audit -> kebab. Also test with voiceover and NVDA. faye: tiny microcopy tweak: visually show 'Via: infra' but aria-label should be the long form. mobile truncation: cut short after 10 chars with ellipsis, long-press opens tooltip with full lineage. anya: perf note: for orgs with 2k members, we will virtualize and only mount tooltip content for visible rows. that's in the perf checklist. aria-bot: Created ticket UX-4481 with checklist: a11y labels, focus order QA, perf gating, i18n tokens. sam: implementation question: do we want the inline Audit link always visible or only when there are recent events? showing it always could be noisy. kevin: prefer conditional: show Audit only if lastRoleChange <= 30 days or if eventCount > 0. reduces noise. lucy: one more accessibility nit: when expand opens, set focus to the expanded region's first interactive element and trap focus within the row until user closes expand with Escape. avoids users tabbing into kebab unexpectedly. faye: agree but avoid heavy focus traps for screen reader users; trap only when expand is modal-like. we'll do focus-return pattern: focus goes back to expand control on close. anya: final decisions: 1) "Assign role" verb, 2) compact badges with aria-labels and navy SSO badge, 3) conditional inline Audit for recent events, 4) expand control tabbable first + focus management (focus-return on close), 5) virtualization + lazy tooltips, 6) localization tokens for 'Via:' short form. i'll update figma + spec and tag eng for estimates. target: dev PR on staging by next Wed. kevin: will add a11y acceptance checklist in the ticket: keyboard order, SR narration, color contrast pass, focus-visible present. sam: i'll slot 3 dev days + 1 qa day pending final assets. thanks all. anya: closing thread unless more feedback. :thumbsup:
